description: A small pile of white rectangular blocks sits on a blue bedspread in front of a pink pillow, with one extra block lying off to the right. The left hand stays planted on the central stack to steady it as a left-hand object, while the right hand picks up the loose block from the right, brings it leftward over the stack, and slides it into place on the top, then presses and adjusts it to align with the upright piece as a right-hand object.
